notes: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe now uses filled fuchsia hearts for the O side and purple X symbols throughout the board. Softer orange turn highlights for Ivan and pale chartreuse green for Lexie/player two. Manual opening dice are the default: best of three, first to two wins, ties replayed. Both players roll for themselves; the recorded roll history and score remain available in a compact Dice score panel. Existing games retain their opening rules and progress.
